title: Global Retailer — Highly available e-commerce platform
scenario: A global retailer is designing a new e-commerce platform on Azure. The platform has a web front end, a REST API layer, and a relational database. It must serve customers worldwide with low latency and remain available even if an entire Azure region fails.
context: Route users to the closest healthy region.
Front end must scale automatically to handle traffic spikes.
Database must survive a regional outage with minimal data loss.
API layer must be secured, throttled, and monitored.

questions.prompt: What should the retailer use to route users to the closest healthy region?
questions.explanation: Azure Front Door provides global Layer-7 routing and health-based failover across regions.

questions.prompt: Which database configuration best meets the 'survive a regional outage with minimal data loss' requirement?
options: Azure SQL Database with active geo-replication (or failover groups)
A single Azure SQL Database in one region
SQL Database with locally redundant backups only
questions.explanation: Active geo-replication (or auto-failover groups) maintains a readable replica in a secondary region with low RPO.

questions.prompt: What should be used to secure, throttle, and monitor the REST API layer?
questions.explanation: API Management provides the gateway for authentication, rate limiting (throttling), and analytics for APIs.

title: Fabrikam Finance — Hybrid identity and governance
scenario: Fabrikam Finance runs on-premises Active Directory and is adopting Azure. They need a single sign-on experience, centralized policy enforcement across many subscriptions, and a disaster-recovery plan with a clear data-loss budget.
context: Users must sign in with their existing on-premises credentials.
Security policies must apply uniformly to all subscriptions.
Finance requires an RPO of 15 minutes for critical VMs.
Management wants to trace application performance in production.

questions.domain: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.prompt: How should Fabrikam enable single sign-on with on-premises credentials?
options: Use Azure Key Vault for passwords
questions.explanation: Microsoft Entra Connect syncs on-premises AD identities to Entra ID for a single sign-on hybrid identity.

questions.domain: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.prompt: How should security policies be applied uniformly to all subscriptions?
options: Assign policies at a management group that contains all subscriptions
Assign policies to each resource individually
Assign policies only to the root subscription
Use resource locks instead of policies
questions.explanation: Applying policy at a management group scope inherits down to all member subscriptions.

questions.prompt: Which service best meets a 15-minute RPO for critical VMs?
options: Azure Site Recovery with continuous replication
questions.explanation: Azure Site Recovery provides continuous (near real-time) replication with low RPO to a secondary region.
